title: Sidebar "Challenges" link bounced every signed-in user back to their home page
evidence: Static read: /open was absent from every role's route allow-list; the live site served the faulty build 05b437f
root_cause: A new route was added to the navigation but not to the AppShell route allow-list
regression_test: components/appshell-nav.test.ts (failed before the fix, passes after)

title: Live /pricing showed placeholder cards and /challenges showed an empty list although the Coin ladder was configured
evidence: Live fetch 2026-10-21: the page regenerated but still held the fallback rows. The home page figures (anonymous key) loaded while both pages using the service-role key failed, so the database was reachable. Vercel screenshots showed the environment variables split across two projects
root_cause: Environment variables were split across two Vercel projects (quizbox and quizbox-app) and the service-role key in the live project was stale; server reads swallowed the error so the cause was invisible
recommended_fix: Owner re-saved the key and redeployed; failure logging added; checkout refusals now carry a support code
status: RESOLVED 2026-10-23: pricing ladder and checkout work; a real GHS 5 payment was received

title: Commit 05b437f pushed 3,884 unrelated files (question-bank scratch folders and images) to main and the release branch
affected: git history of origin/main and origin/release/public-homepage-hardening
evidence: git show --stat 05b437f. No secret or environment files were found by filename or content scan
root_cause: git add -A was run over a working tree that held untracked data
recommended_fix: Replace remote history with the clean commit; ignore question-bank working files
status: RESOLVED 2026-10-23: the owner replaced main and the release branch with clean commit 49f9ff5; .gitignore updated; a local backup tag keeps the old commit

title: Content-Security-Policy is Report-Only (not enforced)
evidence: Live headers show Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only on every page (evidence/live-headers.txt)
root_cause: The CSP was deliberately started in report-only mode and never switched
recommended_fix: Collect reports, then set CSP_MODE to enforce
status: IN PROGRESS: violation reports are collected at /api/ops/csp-report (logged as [csp] lines). Switch to enforce after about a week of clean logs and a Preview test

title: No CI pipeline in the repository; 119 environment-dependent tests are run by no automated gate
evidence: No workflow files in the repository at audit time
root_cause: Quality gates relied on a developer running tests before pushing (Vercel only builds)
recommended_fix: GitHub Actions workflow: type check, lint, tests, build, production audit
status: PARTIAL: .github/workflows/ci.yml added (2026-10-23); first run result to be read on the Actions tab; the live acceptance suites still run by hand

title: Page-level authorization is client-side only; there is no server-side route guard
evidence: Data rules were verified statically (RLS on all public tables, definer functions pin search_path, no anonymous table grants, no permissive policies) so data is protected, but protected page shells are served to anyone
root_cause: Design choice (a single-page shell with Supabase client auth)
recommended_fix: Add a server-side session check in the (app) layout or middleware for defence in depth
regression_test: E2E test: an unauthenticated request for /admin is redirected

title: /api/challenges/view trusts the Origin header and has no rate limit: anyone can inflate view and share counts
evidence: Static read: the Origin check is supplied by the client
root_cause: The Origin header is easy to forge from a non-browser client
recommended_fix: Per-device limit (the help counter route now does this with qb_consume_budget)
regression_test: Route test with a forged Origin

title: /api/ops/refresh-analytics compares the shared secret with !== (not constant time)
recommended_fix: Reuse the timingSafeEqual pattern in lib/cron/auth.ts
regression_test: Unit test with wrong-length and wrong-value secrets

title: npm audit reports 6 high advisories, all in development tooling (eslint-config-next chain; vite via launch-editor)
evidence: None are in the production dependency tree (npm audit --omit=dev reports 0)
recommended_fix: Upgrade eslint-config-next and vitest when compatible
status: OPEN (production tree clean; checked by CI)

title: WITHDRAWN: false positive. The French question text is correct ("A demain" with the accented capital)
evidence: Row inspected with ascii(): the text contains the accented characters; no U+FFFD anywhere in any column of any file. The flag came from option A being the letter A-tilde, which matched the scanner's mojibake pattern, and from the console not displaying accents

title: SHS indicator codes are not prefixed with subject or grade (16 of 37 codes in the three SHS files are shared by more than one subject)
evidence: Deterministic scan of the CSV files
root_cause: The source curriculum numbering (for example 1.1.1.LI.1) repeats per subject
recommended_fix: Make sure loaders and any unique index key on subject plus code; verify on Preview
regression_test: Loader test with two subjects sharing a code

title: Server-side reads swallowed errors (catch returned an empty or fallback value), so production faults were invisible
root_cause: A defensive never-fail-the-page pattern without logging
recommended_fix: Log the error class (never a secret) wherever a fallback is returned
regression_test: lib/pricing/server.test.ts; policy, help and support routes log the same way
status: PARTIAL: pricing, the public challenge list, policies, help and checkout now log why they fall back; other silent catches remain

title: docs/release/APPLY_PRICING.md and the Admin price-link field told the owner to paste payment links on cards (card payments use the built-in checkout)
evidence: The owner exposed seven bundle links earlier because of this wording
recommended_fix: Reword to "for invoice or hand-confirmed sales only"

title: User-uploaded DOCX and PDF files are parsed on the server with only an 8 MB compressed-size cap (decompression-bomb exposure)
root_cause: No decompressed-size or page-count guard before parsing
recommended_fix: Cap decompressed size and entries for DOCX; time-box PDF parsing
regression_test: Fixture test with a zip bomb

title: Not auditable by the auditor: production and Preview databases (the connector saw two unrelated inactive projects), Vercel logs (403), signed-in browser journeys, performance under load
recommended_fix: Provide Preview-scoped test credentials and database access for a follow-up pass

title: Answer-key position bias: the correct answer is "A" in 29.3% of rows (expected near 25%) in the main files and 28.3% in the staged files
evidence: Deterministic count over 63,750 rows (A 18,658 / B 15,841 / C 14,691 / D 14,560)
recommended_fix: The loader already has lib/question-loading/balance.ts (balanceAnswerKey): confirm it runs on every batch before approval. Questions are drawn in random order but options are delivered in stored order
regression_test: Loader test asserting post-balance A-D shares within 22-28%
